model: YOLO11n fine-tuned for one class (pig), ultralytics 8.4.24, trained 23 Nov 2026 on 4,200 frames from seven Edinburgh clips of five days (six-day protocol)
export: ultralytics export format=onnx imgsz=640 opset=12 simplify=True dynamic=False, from reports/detector_2026-11-23/best.pt

input.name: images
input.preprocessing: letterbox the frame to 640 x 640 (keep aspect ratio, pad with grey 114), divide by 255, no mean/std normalisation

output.name: output0
output.units: pixels of the 640 x 640 letterboxed input
output.postprocessing: keep rows with score >= 0.25, non-maximum suppression at IoU 0.7, undo the letterbox to get boxes in the original frame; the model has no NMS inside

tracking: ByteTrack on the kept boxes (ultralytics bytetrack.yaml defaults), one track id per pig
source_video: Edinburgh pig pen camera, 1280 x 720 at 6.04 frames per second; the behaviour model needs 2 boxes per pig per second, so run the detector on every third frame

timing_laptop.note: best of three on an idle laptop; the Edge Impulse profile replaces these for the target device

untested_on_hardware: INT8 quantisation of this detector, latency and power on a Raspberry Pi or similar board. Edge Impulse profiling is the substitute (department email of 23 Nov 2026).
